name: Cerberus
creator: AXIS#Z73DAX “Beymaster1”
description: Cerberus is a mythical three-headed hound forged for unrelenting pursuit. It enters a Killing Frenzy as it tracks its prey, stacking critical strikes and summoning invulnerable shadow clones to overwhelm opponents with fierce multi-hit assaults.

special_move.name: Unleash the Hound
special_move.description: Summons two invulnerable clones of Cerberus. The clones last for 6 rounds and perform 3 separate hits whenever Cerberus uses an Attack. (0 Base Damage).
flavour_texts: 🐺 **Unleash the Hound** — Cerberus howls and summons two ferocious shadow clones to fight at its side!

abilities.name: Killing Frenzy
abilities.description: Cerberus has an obsession with hunting down its prey. Each time an attack successfully lands, it gains a stack of Obsession (+10% Critical Chance per stack, lasting 3 rounds, stacks up to 5 times for +50% max Crit Chance). Acquiring a new stack refreshes the duration of all active stacks.

abilities.name: Triple Bite
abilities.description: While Unleash the Hound is active, Attack and Defense responses trigger 3 times instead of once, resulting in a 2.7x overall power amplification.
